4	 *
5	 * Durable evidence trail for every PayU webhook notification hitting
6	 * `POST /api/payments/webhooks/payu`, written BEFORE the rest of the webhook
7	 * handling flow runs (see `PaymentsWebhookController.handlePayuWebhook()`).
8	 * This is separate from — and does not replace — the money-path outbox row
9	 * written by `PaymentCompletedHandler` (see BR-PAY-OUTBOX-ATOMIC-001); this
10	 * table exists to forensically reconstruct what PayU actually sent us,
11	 * independent of whether the notification was ultimately accepted.
12	 *
13	 * Columns:
14	 *   - payload_sha256: sha256 hex of the raw (pre-parse) webhook body — lets
15	 *     us detect byte-identical retries/replays without storing the raw body.
16	 *   - payload_redacted: jsonb allowlist projection of the PayU payload
17	 *     (orderId, extOrderId, status, totalAmount, currencyCode,
18	 *     localReceiptDateTime ONLY — see

20	 *     excludes `order.customerIp` (PII) and `properties[]` (arbitrary
21	 *     provider-supplied key/value pairs).
22	 *   - headers_redacted: jsonb, exactly the 8 fields produced by
23	 *     `toRedactedHeaders()` — an explicit allowlist, not a blocklist, so an
24	 *     unrecognized header (cookie, authorization, x-forwarded-for, ...) can
25	 *     never leak into storage.
26	 *   - signature_valid: whether `IPaymentGateway.verifyWebhookSignature()`
27	 *     accepted this notification.
28	 *   - source_ip_hash / source_ip_allowlisted / request_id: derived,
29	 *     non-reversible identifiers — `source_ip_hash` is
30	 *     `hashIdentifier(clientIp)` (ANONYMIZATION_SALT), never a raw IP

32	 *     `payment-webhook-redaction.util.ts#isSourceIpAllowlisted`: no PayU
33	 *     source-IP allowlist exists in docs/security/rules/ yet, so this column
34	 *     is written from day one but is not yet meaningfully populated.
35	 *

37	 * (unverified-signature) request would let an attacker cheaply flood this
38	 * table. Instead, failed attempts are aggregated one row per
39	 * (source_ip_hash, hour_bucket) with `attempt_count` incremented via
40	 * `ON CONFLICT ... DO UPDATE` against the partial unique index below. Only
41	 * VERIFIED notifications (signature_valid = true) get a full row per

145	    @Headers(PAYU_SIGNATURE_HEADER) signature: string | undefined,
146	    @Req() req: RawBodyRequest<Request>
147	  ): Promise<Result<WebhookAcknowledgment>> {
148	    this.logger.info('[PaymentsWebhook] Received PayU webhook', {
149	      orderId: body.order?.orderId,
150	      status: body.order?.status,
151	      hasSignature: !!signature,
152	    });
153	
154	    // 1. Verify signature (for security)
155	    // NOTE: req.rawBody requires `rawBody: true` in NestFactory.create() (main.ts).
156	    // A re-serialized JSON body is never byte-identical to the original PayU
157	    // payload, so there is no safe fallback here — a missing rawBody is an
158	    // internal configuration error, not something to silently work around.
159	    if (!req.rawBody) {
160	      this.logger.error('[PaymentsWebhook] req.rawBody is undefined — rawBody:true misconfigured', {
161	        orderId: body.order?.orderId,
162	      });
163	      return Result.fail(new PaymentWebhookProcessingFailedError(body.order?.orderId ?? 'unknown'));
164	    }
165	
166	    const rawBody = req.rawBody.toString();
167	    const signatureValid = this.paymentGateway.verifyWebhookSignature(rawBody, signature || '');
168	
169	    if (!signatureValid) {
170	      this.logger.warn('[PaymentsWebhook] Invalid PayU signature', {
171	        orderId: body.order?.orderId,
172	      });
173	      return Result.fail(new ValidationError('Invalid webhook signature'));
174	    }
175	
176	    // 2. Extract payment information
177	    const externalPaymentId = body.order.orderId;
178	    const payuStatus = body.order.status;
179	    const internalStatus = mapPayuStatusToInternal(payuStatus);
180	
181	    this.logger.debug('[PaymentsWebhook] Processing payment status', {
182	      externalPaymentId,
183	      payuStatus,
184	      internalStatus,
185	    });
186	
187	    // 3. Dispatch CompletePaymentCommand
188	    const command = new CompletePaymentCommand(
189	      externalPaymentId,
190	      internalStatus,
191	      body as unknown as Record<string, unknown>,
192	      internalStatus === 'FAILED' ? `PayU status: ${payuStatus}` : undefined
193	    );
194	
195	    const result = await this.commandBus.execute<
196	      CompletePaymentCommand,
197	      Result<CompletePaymentResult>
198	    >(command);
199	
200	    if (result.isFailure) {
201	      // Idempotent duplicate (payment already reached a terminal state via an
202	      // earlier notification): retrying will never resolve this, so we
203	      // acknowledge it the same way a fresh success would be acknowledged —
204	      // this is NOT a failure PayU should retry on.
205	      const isIdempotentDuplicate =
206	        result.error instanceof PaymentAlreadyCompletedError ||
207	        result.error instanceof PaymentAlreadyFailedError;
208	
209	      if (isIdempotentDuplicate) {
210	        this.logger.info('[PaymentsWebhook] Idempotent duplicate webhook notification', {
211	          externalPaymentId,
212	          errorType: result.error.constructor.name,
213	        });
214	        return Result.ok({
215	          acknowledged: true,
216	          processedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
217	        });
218	      }
219	
220	      // Any other failure (not-found, repository/outbox errors, unexpected
221	      // domain rule violations) is NOT known to be unfixable by a retry, so
222	      // it must surface as a 5xx and let PayU retry — silently swallowing it
223	      // as 200 (the previous behavior) hid genuine failures (TM-TOPUP-R1).
224	      // TODO(TS-TOKEN-TOPUP-001 Faza 0, część A2): po dodaniu tabeli
225	      // payment_gateway_raw_notifications, 2xx ma zależeć od udanego zapisu
226	      // wiersza, nie tylko od przetworzenia komendy.
227	      this.logger.error('[PaymentsWebhook] Failed to complete payment', {
228	        externalPaymentId,
229	        errorType: result.error.constructor.name,
230	        error: result.error.message,
231	      });
232	      return Result.fail(new PaymentWebhookProcessingFailedError(externalPaymentId));
233	    }
234	
235	    this.logger.info('[PaymentsWebhook] Payment completed successfully', {
236	      externalPaymentId,
237	      paymentId: result.value.paymentId,
238	      contextType: result.value.contextType,
239	      contextEntityId: result.value.contextEntityId,
240	    });
241	
242	    return Result.ok({
243	      acknowledged: true,
244	      paymentId: result.value.paymentId,
245	      processedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
246	    });
247	  }

    description: >

      (Tier 1 event, ADR-0027) happens in PaymentCompletedHandler
      (application/event-handlers/, @EventHandler(PaymentCompletedEvent)) —
      NOT in CompletePaymentHandler (the command handler). PaymentCompletedHandler

      BaseCommandHandler.executeTransactional(), where @Transactional() converts

      the payment completion and the missing outbox row atomically, so a payment
      can never commit as COMPLETED with no corresponding outbox row (the bug
      the previous log-and-continue behavior allowed). This is a deliberate,
      narrow, money-path-only exception to the "never throw from an event

      "Event Emission Rules" ("Integration events ONLY from domain event

      payload/headers:

          totalAmount, currencyCode, localReceiptDateTime

          the frozen set (cookie, authorization, x-forwarded-for, ...) is
          silently dropped and only contributes to a caller-side
          `unknownHeaderCount`, which is itself NOT persisted.

          keyed by `ANONYMIZATION_SALT` — never a raw IP address (SI5).
